rows.en: Press the D-pad up, left or right twice quickly in the same direction to roll that way.
Also, guarding resets the camera angle to face front.
Press the L and R buttons together to release lock-on.
Press the D-pad down twice quickly to fire the reverse thrusters and brake hard.
With both units on the field, use the Select button and the D-pad together to give tactical commands.
The Square button attacks the locked-on enemy with your main weapon.
Push the analog pad up to transform into Fighter mode.
Hold the L button and press the Circle button to spend one block of SP gauge on a charged shot.
The Circle button attacks the locked-on enemy with your special weapon.
That covers the basic controls for Fighter mode. Note that you cannot transform into any other mode in this training.
Hold the L button and press the Triangle button to spend one block of SP gauge on a charged melee attack.
For units with several special weapons, hold L and press Square to switch special weapons.
Now, please begin the Fighter mode flight training.
Press the Triangle and Circle buttons together to spend three blocks of SP gauge on a powerful special attack.
Some special weapons can multi-lock, locking onto several enemies at once.
The training ends when you reach the target area or the time limit runs out.
Press the Square and X buttons together to spend a set amount of SP gauge on the pilot's own command skill.
For multi-lock, keep holding the Circle button to lock onto several enemies within firing range.

rows.en: Arrival at the target area confirmed. Ending the Fighter flight training.
Hold L and press Triangle and Circle together for a combined special attack with both units.
Release the Circle button during multi-lock to hit every enemy locked so far with your special weapon.
Training time is up. Ending the Fighter flight training.
A combined special attack uses six blocks of SP gauge.
These shooting attacks use the same controls in Fighter, Battroid and GERWALK modes.
I will now explain the basic controls for Battroid mode.
That covers the basic special moves.
That's the basics of shooting attacks.
Press the D-pad up, down, left or right to move forward, back, left or right.

Targets will appear. Practice your shooting attacks.
Press the D-pad twice quickly in one direction to step that way.
The training ends when you reach the target area or time runs out.
The training ends when you reach the target area or the time limit expires.

Press the X button to jump.
Training time is up.
Training time is up. Ending shooting attack training.
Press the X button twice quickly and keep holding it to descent-boost and lose altitude.

Now for the basics of melee attacks.

Approach a container while locked onto it and you can pick it up.

You can only carry containers in GERWALK or Battroid mode. Be careful.
In Battroid and GERWALK modes, pressing the Triangle button repeatedly chains a combo.
That covers the basic controls for Battroid mode. Note that you cannot transform into any other mode in this training.
Press Square to set the container down here.
The number of hits in a combo differs by unit and mode.

Hold the Triangle button for a while and then release it for a charged melee attack.

Arrival at the target area confirmed. Ending the Battroid flight training.
The training ends when you bring the container to the designated spot, reach the target area, or run out of time.
In Battroid mode, press the Triangle button on a downed enemy for a down attack.
Training time is up. Ending the Battroid flight training.
All containers recovered. That ends the container transport training.

Keep holding the D-pad at the end of a step to dash.

Keep holding the X button to boost upward and gain altitude.
In GERWALK mode you can hover and hold your altitude.
